correctness.rationale: The explicit nine-term tuple has a closed matrix-unit cycle whose degrees spell the Baumslag relator. Any finite regrading therefore yields a finite image of Baumslag's group. Baumslag's 1969 theorem makes that image cyclic, and the defining relation then forces the image of a to be the identity, contradicting distinct reindexing of the nonzero a- and identity-components. The standard graded-subalgebra extension gives all n>=9.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2018 paper asks for the exact threshold, and the current 2026 Gordienko--Pekarsky version gives counterexamples for n>=14. Targeted exact, synonymous, dimensional, and Baumslag-group searches did not locate the M_9 construction or an equal-or-better bound, and no overlapping SCOPE record was found.

value.rationale: The construction improves the current finite-regrading obstruction dimension from 14 to 9 and narrows the threshold from 3<=n_0<=13 to 3<=n_0<=8, using an explicit field-independent grading and a classical one-relator finite-quotient obstruction.
